item.description:

item.title: Tracks East - Roots! Where Do You Come From? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (20.06.2023)

item.description:

item.description:

item.title: Tracks East - This is my body! (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (13.06.2023)
item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.title: #AMINORMAL (5/8) - How to Make Friends With Food (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (31.01.2022)
item.description:
Do you sometimes secretly eat so much that your stomach hurts? These interviews show that you are not alone. And if a lot of people do that, it's kind of normal, isn't it? item.title: Just Dance - Final Year at the Paris Conservatoire (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (29.12.2023)
item.description:

item.title: Tracks East - Israel: Life After Terror (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (17.11.2023)
item.description:
In Israel everything changed overnight on 7 October. In this episode, Tracks East looks at life in the Jewish state after the Hamas attack.

item.description:

item.title: Tracks East - The War Inside (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.04.2023)
item.description:

item.title: Tracks East - Anti-Putin Russians (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (17.05.2023)
item.description:

item.title: Tracks East - Eurovision: Pop and Politics (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.05.2023)
item.description:

item.title: Tracks East - When Politics Destroys Families (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (20.06.2023)
item.description:

item.title: Tracks East - Pacifism: What’s the Point? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (20.04.2023)

item.title: How Streaming Consumed Music (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (19.09.2023)
item.description:

He traces the history of our listening habits in the 21st century through the mp3, illegal downloads, the iPod, to streaming services.....

item.title: The Worlds of Philip K. Dick (07.12.2023)
item.description:

item.description:

item.title: Tracks East - The Polish Paradox (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (29.09.2023)
item.description:

item.description:
Human beings have always dreamed of being able to fly. This dream has come true thanks to the largest wind tunnel in Europe located near Milan. Initially designed for aeronautics and aerospace, these indoor simulators are now open to all. A new sport has emerged thanks to these massive wind tunnels: part athlete, part dancer, and part bird, sportsmen and women have learned to tame the 200km winds .....

item.title: The Postman of the Taiga (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.01.2024)

item.description:
In the village of Asau in north-east Romania, locals take part in the annual bear dance. The pre-Christian rite is a joyful occasion where bear-skin wearing dancers take to the streets in a lively procession that expresses local identity.

item.title: 360° Reportage - Rapa Nui - Gladiators of the Pacific (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (29.01.2024)

item.description:
The hargila or Greater adjutant, one of the largest storks on the planet, was listed as endangered in 2014. item.title: 360° Reportage - Sulawesi: The Art of Boat Building (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (21.11.2023)
item.description:
The Sulawesi Pinisi is a highly manoeuvrable cargo sailing vessel. During the Dutch colonial era, it was used to sail between the Indonesian islands, carrying everything from simple goods to precious commodities for export, particularly spices. The art of making these handsome ships was inscribed on the UNESCO list of Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2017.

item.title: Geo Reportage - The Green Lungs of Europe (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.12.2023)
item.description:
In Europe, the last primary forests are found almost exclusively in the mountains in the east or south-east of the continent. These virgin forests have never been exploited or cut down, and have remained as they have always been. Few studies have been done on this forests, which are presumably havens of biodiversity. We go on a research trip to the Dinaric Alps in Albania.
From 02.12.2023 05:00

item.title: 360° Reportage - Australia: Mission Platypus (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (22.01.2024)
item.description:
The platypus is a very strange species in a country with many unusual animals. Equipped with their characteristic beaks and thick fur, they are a fascinating hybrid which lay eggs  like birds or reptiles, and yet nurse their young like mammals. In the last few hundred years they have become increasingly endangered but new protection and resettlement schemes are ensuring a comeback.

item.title: 360° Reportage - Paris: City of Bees (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (27.12.2023)
item.description:
Paris is a dream destination for tourists from all over the world. What is less well known is that it is home to millions and millions of bees. Thanks to its historic gardens and tree-lined avenues, the capital offers them a huge variety of flowers. Why not take a bee's eye view of the "City of Light"?

item.title: Amazonia - The Floating Courthouse (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.12.2023)

item.title: 360° Reportage - Newfoundland: Stay or Leave? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (27.12.2023)

According to elected officials, this is a cheaper solution than maintaining the infrastructure. But local people are divided on the issue.

item.title: The Isle of Rum (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.02.2024)
item.description:

item.title: Japan's Tattooed Heroes (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (21.01.2024)

But one art form has almost been forgotten: the traditional tattoo - the Horimono. Once highly popular, it has now become the symbol of the criminal yakuza, and its true history is barely known.

item.title: 360° Reportage - New York Food Trucks (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.02.2024)
item.description:
Food trucks are everywhere in New York, especially in Astoria, Queens, a district that symbolises the American melting pot more than any other: Nowhere else is there such linguistic and cultural diversity. The result is a rich food culture with culinary specialities from all over the world.

item.title: National Parks: A Macro View - Dovrefjell-Sunndalsfjella in Norway (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (30.01.2024)
item.description:
A surprising number of flora and fauna that can withstand the extreme conditions of the Arctic, and have shown an extraordinary capacity for adaptation to survive. Whipped by icy winds, this tundra is a land without trees, with very short summers. The first Norwegians settled here to follow wild reindeer, in this land that is as desolate is it is beautiful.

item.title: The Year of the Bear (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.02.2024)
item.description:

item.title: Fragile and Beautiful Mediterranean - The Strait of Messina (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (08.09.2023)

The waters of the Strait of Messina, which separates the Italian peninsula from Sicily, are virtually unexplored due to the powerful currents generated by the meeting of the Ionian and Tyrrhenian Seas, currents which also supports an exceptional biodiversity.

item.title: Fragile and Beautiful Mediterranean - Pelagos: Marine Mammal Sanctuary (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (08.09.2023)

Covering an area of 87,500 square kilometres, the Pelagos sanctuary was created specifically to protect large marine mammals. Many species such as dolphins, whales, rorquals, and sperm whales feed and reproduce in this maritime area, which stretches from France to Italy and surrounds Corsica.

item.title: Wild Berlin - Animals of the Metropolis (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (16.01.2024)
item.description:
Around 100 beavers live in the rivers and lakes of Berlin. But accommodation on the waterfront is in high demand and the beaver habitat is being encroached on by property developers. It's just one of many animals to make Berlin home; there's urban gulls taking over a shopping centre roof, and the nightingale, which has a particularly fondness for Berlin.

item.title: The Fight for the Great Barrier Reef (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (21.12.2023)
item.description:
The Great Barrier Reef is considered one of the seven natural wonders of the world. The biodiversity of this unique ecosystem is crucial for the global balance of the oceans. However, climate change threatens this balance. Australian scientists are working on innovative solutions to protect the reef. But the challenges are significant, and time is running out.
From 21.12.2023 05:00
